question:
The line chart given below shows the population of two states P and Q in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f041c20c33aa936e1c444fcc0e2c0862b3a9a1a6b63d297be22f13c23128460.png] 

What is the difference between the total population of P and Q in all the years?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total population of Q = 300 + 200 + 125 + 75 + 150 = 850

Total population of P = 150 + 250 + 175 + 100 + 50 = 725

Difference = 850 - 725 = 125

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
